## Test Summary

Story types per `.claude/docs/coding-standards.md §Testing Standards`:

- **Logic** — formula / state-machine / pure-data. BLOCKING automated unit test required.
- **Integration** — multi-system / cross-plugin. BLOCKING automated test required.
- **Visual/Feel** — appearance / animation / VFX. ADVISORY screenshot + lead sign-off; not auto-closed by tests alone. Sprint 15 story 020 elevates to BLOCKING integration-test (ECS-marker / colour / z-layer assertions; no rendered-pixel snapshot) per AC9.
- **UI** — menu / HUD / screen layout. Manual walkthrough doc OR interaction test; ADVISORY gate.
- **Doc-only** — design spec / doc / paperwork. ADVISORY producer + ux-designer + art-director sign-off; no automated test.
- **Paperwork** — `production/sprint-status.yaml` row-status flip; `git diff` is the verification.
- **Manual / Visual eyeball (human-operator-blocked)** — manual two-client run + screenshot capture; no LLM `/story-done` authorised.

### QA Policy — Test Scope Per Prompt Type

Per Sprint 13 / Sprint 14 binding precedent and per PROMPT 1002 task instruction:

- **Normal implementation workers** (`/dev-story` for Should/Nice rows 3, 4, 5) run **story-prescribed targeted tests only** plus justified adjacent regressions named in the story file (e.g. story 020 AC17 lists 8 named regression bins). Full workspace test invocations are **NOT** run inside a single-row `/dev-story` worker.
- **Integration prompts** (one per merged worker branch) run **targeted verification for the branch being integrated only** — typically the same test bins the worker ran plus any rebase-adjacent regression. No full workspace tests by default.
- **Smoke / checkpoint prompts** (`/smoke-check` at end of sprint; any mid-sprint checkpoint at producer discretion) **MAY run `cargo test --workspace --tests --no-fail-fast` serialized** against the Cargo resource policy below. This is the only context in which a full workspace test is authorised.
- **Doc-only `/dev-story`** (row 4, story 013) does NOT run cargo at all. Verification is heading scan + cross-reference grep + producer/ux/art ratification.
- **Paperwork-only prompts** (row 2 row-flip; this `/qa-plan`) do NOT run cargo.
- **Manual / visual eyeball capture** (row 1) does NOT run cargo; the human operator runs a real two-client browser build and captures screenshots.

### Cargo Resource Policy on Windows/MSVC (Binding for all Sprint 15 Cargo invocations)

All Sprint 15 `cargo fmt` / `cargo check` / `cargo test` / `cargo build` invocations on Windows/MSVC MUST set the following environment variables to avoid PDB / disk-pressure issues observed in Sprints 11–14 (binding precedent from PROMPT 815 disk-pressure incident; preserved across PROMPT 833 / 844 / 851 / 872 / 884 / 889 / 902 / 906 / 907 / 912 / 917 / 918 / 930 / 938 / 941 / 951 / 955 / 959 / 961 / 970 / 973 / 975 / 982 / 983 worker + integration prompts):

```powershell
$env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR='D:\_DEV\cargo-target\ccgs-msvc'
$env:CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG='0'
$env:CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG='0'
$env:CARGO_INCREMENTAL='0'
$env:RUSTFLAGS='-C debuginfo=0 -C link-arg=/DEBUG:NONE'
```

This preamble MUST be applied at the top of **every** future Sprint 15 cargo command block — `/dev-story` worker prompts, integration prompts, smoke prompts, story-done prompts (if they re-run targeted tests), and any team-QA / gate-check prompts that invoke cargo.

**Stale target cleanup authorisation**: workers MAY clear `D:\_DEV\cargo-target\ccgs-msvc\` between invocations if disk pressure exceeds threshold. Cleanup authorisation is **implicit in this plan**. Before clearing, workers MUST verify the path with `Test-Path 'D:\_DEV\cargo-target\ccgs-msvc'` (PowerShell) or `test -d 'D:\_DEV\cargo-target\ccgs-msvc'` (Bash) and confirm it is the canonical Sprint 15 target dir before issuing `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force 'D:\_DEV\cargo-target\ccgs-msvc\*'` or `rm -rf 'D:/_DEV/cargo-target/ccgs-msvc/'*`. Do not clear directories outside the canonical Sprint 15 target dir; do not clear `D:\_DEV\cargo-target\ccgs-msvc` itself (only its contents).

## Bevy 0.18 UI Constraints & Responsive Layout Expectations

Sprint 15 lands all UI changes on **Bevy 0.18** (project pinned 2026-04-28 per `docs/engine-reference/bevy/VERSION.md`). Workers MUST activate the `liv-bevy-018` skill on every `.rs` file change touching `bevy` (`client/src/`, `tests/integration/`).

### Bevy 0.18 API binding (story 020, story 008 — the two `.rs` Should/Nice rows)

The following Bevy 0.18 API patterns are BLOCKING for both Sprint 15 `.rs` rows:

- **Required Components API** (introduced 0.15, refined through 0.18): bundles like `NodeBundle`, `TextBundle`, `ImageBundle`, `ButtonBundle` are **deprecated**. Use the `Node` component plus Required Components. The `liv-bevy-018` skill enforces this.
- **`LineHeight` required component** (introduced 0.18): every `Text` spawn that controls vertical rhythm declares `LineHeight` explicitly. Sprint 14 typography module (story 003) exports the canonical `LINE_HEIGHT_DEFAULT_RATIO` for downstream consumption.
- **`UiImage` → `ImageNode` migration** (introduced 0.16): if any Sprint 15 row touches image consumers (story 020 hand drag visuals may add overlay child nodes), they use `ImageNode`.
- **`Query::single()` returns `Result`** (introduced 0.16): every Sprint 15 system that previously used `query.single()` propagates the `Result` with `?` or explicit `Ok(_)` match; **no `unwrap()` in production paths** per technical preferences.
- **`ChildOf` replaces `Parent`** (introduced 0.16): every reparent operation in story 020 fan-slot overlay child nodes uses `ChildOf` not deprecated `Parent`.
- **`Event::write()` replaces `Event::send()`** (introduced 0.16): not expected in Sprint 15 (story 020 + story 008 are read-only over ECS state); enforce if any row needs to emit a new event.
- **`despawn` replaces `despawn_recursive`** (introduced 0.16): not expected in Sprint 15 (overlay child nodes are toggled via `Visibility` per story 020 AC7, not despawned).

### Lightyear 0.26 binding

Sprint 15 has **zero networking-adjacent work**. Story 020 explicitly forbids new server-authoritative state per AC8 ADR-012 binding (`shared/src/protocol.rs` diff must be empty). Story 008 is a design-token module with no networking semantics. Story 013 is doc-only. `liv-bevy-lightyear` skill activation is **NOT required** for any Sprint 15 row.

### Responsive layout expectations

Sprint 15 inherits the **friend-game responsive matrix** established in Sprint 14:

| Viewport size | Aspect | Required by | Notes |
|---------------|--------|-------------|-------|
| 1366×768 | 16:9 | Story 020 ADVISORY screenshots | Minimum supported viewport. |
| 1920×1080 | 16:9 | Story 020 ADVISORY screenshots | Canonical desktop viewport. |

Sprint 15 does NOT establish a new responsive matrix; it consumes the existing one. **Friend-game scope only**: does NOT advance Standard-tier responsive accessibility (`QA-COND-0005` accepted-risk).

### Read-only-over-server-authoritative-state invariant

All Sprint 15 implementation rows are **read-only over server-authoritative state**:
